services.value: AEL provides analytical environmental testing services including PFAS analysis using Liquid Chromatography Tandem Mass Spectrometry (LC-MS/MS), as well as UCMR 5, drinking water testing, and general environmental laboratory testing for water, soil, and related matrices. The text also mentions in-house reporting and analytical testing in wet chemistry, organics, metals, microbiological, and nutrient testing, along with sampling and courier services.
